title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Decision Table: Card Basis of a Fill by Dispensing Pharmacy and Deductible Payment
content:
For a Specialty Pharmacy Program fill, the card basis is the amount a manufacturer copay card may pay toward. It depends on which pharmacy dispensed the fill and on how much of the fill's deductible portion the member has already paid.

**Rule.**

- The card basis of a fill dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy that carries a deductible portion, of which the member's own payments on the fill cover less than all, is the fill's whole cost share less what the member has already paid on it. The card pays the rest of the deductible portion first.
- The card basis of a fill dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy or a retail pharmacy is zero.
- The card basis of any other fill is its copay portion, meaning its total cost share less its deductible portion. In that case the member has paid the deductible portion.

The member's own payments on the fill are the member payments posted on the enrollment's ledger that name that fill. The dispensing pharmacy and the deductible portion are as booked on the fill's shipment.

## Decision table

| Dispensing pharmacy | Deductible portion on the fill | Member's own payments on the fill | Card basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | above zero | less than the deductible portion | whole cost share less the member's payments on the fill |
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | above zero | equal to or more than the deductible portion | total cost share less the deductible portion |
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | zero | any | total cost share less the deductible portion, which here is the whole cost share |
| Outside specialty pharmacy | any | any | zero |
| Retail pharmacy | any | any | zero |

## Both sides of the member-payment threshold (assumed fill: cost share $200.00, deductible portion $80.00, dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy)

| Member's own payments on the fill | Covers all of the deductible portion? | Card basis |
|---|---|---|
| $0.00 | No | $200.00 |
| $30.00 | No | $170.00 |
| $79.99 | No | $120.01 |
| $80.00 | Yes | $120.00 |
| $100.00 | Yes | $120.00 |

## Cases (assumed facts)

- *The same fill dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy.* The card basis is zero, whatever the member has paid.
- *A Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy fill with a $60.00 cost share and no deductible portion.* The card basis is $60.00.
